tokens.name: neon-pink
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Primary fills (PressButton, stats button, progress fill, hint disc label), active borders, the player-count number and night-theme eyebrows. White text on it is 3.4:1; as text on cream it is 3.2:1 (player count, bold 16px) — both below 4.5:1, kept exact and flagged: use only at bold 19px+ (button labels are bold 14px in the source — flagged).

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Second stripe of WashiTape and the end of the ProgressBar gradient.

tokens.name: pink-deep
tokens.usage: Eyebrow / cap labels on day surfaces (`text-[#C62368]`); 5.3:1 on paper. Also the deepest stop of the default album cover palette.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Gradient partner of neon-pink: scrollbar thumbs, album-index progress, lightest album cover stop.

tokens.name: logo-pink
tokens.usage: Wordmark gradient top (with logo-coral) and PWA theme-color.

tokens.name: logo-coral
tokens.usage: Wordmark gradient bottom.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Neo-brutalist ink: 2px borders and solid offset shadows on day surfaces, body text on day. Constant in both themes (the vinyl sleeve and tooltips stay ink at night).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Pixelated-mode page ground and the 'It' half of the mode wordmark. Constant across themes.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground. Day = cream (Pixelated `--kp-cream`); night = the Collections night sheet base. Day pages add a 28px pink grid (neon-pink at 12%) or the paper texture.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on the page (ThemedCard, CollectionCard, album index rows). Day = white with ink border + offset; night = #16181e with a 10% white border.

tokens.name: surface-paper
tokens.usage: Modal panels, dropdown lists, Pills and IconButtons on day — the warm 'paper' white. Night modals reuse the card colour with a neon-pink border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Nested panels inside a card (ProgressCard) and the active carousel button at night.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of progress bars and segment meters.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and sheets (`bg-[#1e141c]/55`), with a 4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 2px card border. Day = ink; night = 10% white so cards recede.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of the FOCUSED surface: modals, close buttons, outline buttons. Day = ink, night = neon-pink.

tokens.name: offset
tokens.usage: Colour of the solid offset shadow on modals and outline buttons (6px/3px/2px). Night flips to neon-pink so the depth stays visible on dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page, surface-card and surface-paper (19:1 / 18:1).

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Titles inside modals and info rows (`#3c2f38`); 12:1 on paper.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on cards: descriptions, Korean sub-labels, sticker counts. 6.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-muted-2
tokens.usage: Body of modal info rows and card meta (`#7a6b74`); 4.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary 8–9px caps (locked / 'Coming soon'). Only 3.2:1 on white and 3.5:1 night — fails 4.5:1 at that size; kept exact from source, flagged.

tokens.name: text-on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on neon-pink fills. 3.4:1 — bold 19px+ only for AA; the source uses it at bold 14px (flagged).

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on ink (19:1) and on GuessRow result fills with a dark text-shadow (3.1:1 on incorrect, 1.3:1 on correct — flagged).

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct guess fill (GuessRow, PixelCluster). Pair with ink border and the cluster shape — never colour alone. The source sets WHITE text on it (1.3:1, saved only by a dark text-shadow) — flagged; prefer ink text in the redesign.

tokens.name: correct-edge
tokens.usage: Border of correct PixelCluster squares.

tokens.name: incorrect
tokens.usage: Wrong guess fill and higher/lower arrows. Differs from `correct` mainly by hue (lightness 2.4:1) — rows also differ by the cluster shape; flagged for colour-blind safety.

tokens.name: incorrect-edge
tokens.usage: Border of wrong PixelCluster squares.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: Partial match (Classic feedback square).

tokens.name: level-gold
tokens.usage: Card level 2 frame + offset (CardGrantedReveal) and gold foil.

tokens.name: level-holo
tokens.usage: Card level 3 (max) frame + offset and holo foil accent.

tokens.name: reward-yellow
tokens.usage: 'Group photo unlocked!' highlight text on ink.

tokens.name: sleeve-year
tokens.usage: Hint sleeve #01 (Release Year) paper.

tokens.name: sleeve-year-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sleeve-year (6.7:1).

tokens.name: sleeve-artist
tokens.usage: Hint sleeve #02 (Artist) paper.

tokens.name: sleeve-artist-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sleeve-artist (9.3:1).

tokens.name: vinyl
tokens.usage: Vinyl groove base and the documented shadow undertone (dark purple instead of pure black).

tokens.name: key-light
tokens.usage: Warm key light (top-right, 15–20% opacity) on 3D objects like the vinyl.

tokens.name: fill-light
tokens.usage: Cool fill light (left, 10–14%) — always the opposite temperature of the key.

tokens.name: album-deep
tokens.usage: Default album cover palette — deep.

tokens.name: album-secondary
tokens.usage: Default album cover palette — secondary.

tokens.name: album-main
tokens.usage: Default album cover palette — main; frames base-level group photos.

tokens.name: album-accent
tokens.usage: Default album cover palette — accent.

tokens.name: album-light
tokens.usage: Default album cover palette — light (alias of coral in code).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Kpopit wordmark: logo-pink→logo-coral gradient clipped to text.

styles.name: mode-title
styles.usage: Mode wordmarks ('PixelIt'): two-part gradient text, 'Pixel' pink + 'It' cream.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Big percentage / stat numbers in neon-pink.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: GuessRow album name, hint sleeve label. Truncate, don't wrap.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI copy (DynaPuff is the body font).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and pills (pills at 11px).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Group name under a title, secondary meta.

styles.name: album-title
styles.usage: Collection / album names, ALWAYS uppercase. Clamp 22–34px.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: Modal headings, uppercase.

styles.name: stat-mono
styles.usage: Album stats page figures.

styles.name: cap
styles.usage: Eyebrows above titles ('HOW IT WORKS', 'THEMED'), uppercase, in pink-deep (day) / neon-pink (night).

styles.name: cap-sm
styles.usage: Tag + meta caps on small cards. Below legibility floor — keep to non-essential info.

styles.name: hand-lg
styles.usage: Handwritten notes on stickers and sleeves ('Guess the album', 'Yesterday's album was…').

styles.name: hand-md
styles.usage: Same voice on mobile.

styles.name: sans-body
styles.usage: Long descriptions in cards (collection description).
styles.sample: Collect a sticker for every idol you guess.

styles.name: sans-title
styles.usage: Info-row titles in modals.

styles.name: sans-small
styles.usage: Info-row bodies and helper copy.
styles.sample: Each daily win adds a sticker to this album.

styles.name: sans-label
styles.usage: Album labels above titles, uppercase.

styles.name: korean
styles.usage: Every Hangul string, always Noto Sans KR.

styles.name: korean-sub
styles.usage: Korean sub-label under a hint label, at 60% opacity.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-48

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tiny book covers, progress segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Album cover thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hint sleeves.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cover thumbnails in rows, reward banner, replay-tour button, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: ProgressCard.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: ThemedCard, sleeve, stats IconButton, search field input.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Modals and CollectionCard — the signature large radius.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Search bar shell, victory stat tiles, sleeve bottom.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: PressButtons, Pills, GuessRows, close buttons, progress bars.

shadow.note: Solid offset shadows are the depth language; diffuse shadows only for physical objects, dropdowns and modal backdrops.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Resting PressButton / stats button: a solid 4px drop. Pressed = press-down + translateY(4px).

tokens.name: press-down
tokens.usage: Active (pressed) state of PressButton.

tokens.name: offset-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, index rows, modal close button.

tokens.name: offset-md
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, floating close buttons. Pressed = none + translate(2px,2px).

tokens.name: offset-lg
tokens.usage: Cards on the page (ThemedCard, ProgressCard). Night drops the offset for a soft lift.

tokens.name: offset-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the CollectionCard — the strongest flat depth.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: GuessRow: solid ink drop plus a faint ambient cast.

tokens.name: cover
tokens.usage: Album cover chip inside a GuessRow.

tokens.name: sleeve
tokens.usage: Large physical objects (album sleeve, vinyl) — the only diffuse shadows.

tokens.name: hint-sleeve
tokens.usage: Paper hint sleeves.

tokens.name: dropdown
tokens.usage: Search suggestion list.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: WashiTape strips.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Pills, PixelCluster squares.

tokens.name: border-base
tokens.usage: Default: cards, buttons, rows, modals, sleeves.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: CollectionCard.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Reward banner frame; max for UI (4px only for intentional emphasis).
